normal_uv: FinishBake (UV1), dense per-face finish charts; same axis orientation as UV0; baked in UV0 tangent basis
normal_binding: ONE final Finish_Normal per slot on FinishBake UV1, using UV0 tangents. Cast grain, pits, Torx/ribs/optics microdetail and bevel normals are combined by baking. No stacking.

housing.metallic: 0 painted; up to .90 on worn fasteners and .86 on exposed chips
housing.weathering: Mostly bright silver exposed metal on edges/fasteners; localized oxidation at fasteners, lower edges and gravity-directed drips. Cage has the strongest local bloom.
housing.edge_wear: Continuous irregular rubbed edges with sparse wider chips; metric low-frequency mask, no grain threshold gating.

lens.roughness: .18-.45 effective ORM roughness (generator clamps to .18); flood clear coat roughness .025
lens.tint_basis: Normalized linear RGB approximation at the prescribed Kelvin value.

frame: metres; origin at mount back (roof: underside); +X forward; Z up
source: deterministic, locally authored geometry and procedural PBR; producer reference controls design
approval: not approved; round 4 independent check; producer approval pending
lod_textures: Both LODs occupy disjoint charts in the same seven maps; both are painted and independently normal-baked.
review_day: Neutral sky plus SUN, concrete wall/roof support; LampLevel .05 (dim on) or 0 (off). Night LampLevel 1.
normal_authoring_inputs: source/bake_inputs/*_Micro_Normal.png are generator intermediates, not runtime maps. Cage lens frost uses a 3D position-noise bake to avoid UV stretching.

Housing.method: Invalid negative/grazing bevel normals and unused atlas background replaced by authored DirectX micro-normal on the same UV1; valid bevel samples preserved

Lens.method: Invalid negative/grazing bevel normals and unused atlas background replaced by authored DirectX micro-normal on the same UV1; valid bevel samples preserved
